name: opt-in-before-capture-touch-internal-referrer
description: recordDirectTouch: a same-site referrer on an empty payload means the visit began before capture (for example before consent), so the placeholder is 'Unknown (before capture)', not direct.
quirk_decision: CONTRACT (opt-in, #56): default still returns { kind: 'none', reason: 'internal_referrer' }. Semver: additive opt-in parse option (minor); defaults, CLASSIFIER_VERSION and SCHEMA_VERSION unchanged.
